source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְזֶה־מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לְעֹלָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said David, This [is] [the] house of Yahweh the God, and this [is the] altar for burnt offering for Israel.

en.L: And David said, "This [is] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God, and this [is] the altar for burnt offering for Israel."
en.B: Then David declared, "Here is the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God, and here is the altar of burnt offering for Israel."
en.R: Then David said, "The house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God will be here, and this will be the altar where Israel offers burnt offerings."

es.L: Y dijo David: «Esta [es] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Dios, y este [es] el altar del holocausto para Israel».
es.B: Entonces David declaró: «Aquí está la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Dios, y aquí está el altar del holocausto para Israel».
es.R: Entonces David dijo: «Aquí estará la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Dios, y este será el altar donde Israel ofrecerá sus holocaustos».

fr.L: Et David dit : « C’[est] ici la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} Dieu, et c’[est] ici l’autel des holocaustes pour Israël. »
fr.B: Alors David déclara : « Voici la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} Dieu, et voici l’autel des holocaustes pour Israël. »
fr.R: Alors David a dit : « C’est ici que sera la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} Dieu, et ce sera ici l’autel où Israël offrira ses holocaustes. »

sw.L: Daudi akasema, "Hii [ndiyo] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, na hii [ndiyo] madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya Israeli."
sw.B: Kisha Daudi akatangaza, "Hapa ndipo nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, na hapa ndipo madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya Israeli."
sw.R: Kisha Daudi akasema, "Nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu itakuwa hapa, na hapa ndipo patakapokuwa madhabahu ambapo Israeli watatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa."

vi.L: Đa-vít nói: "Đây [là] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, và đây [là] bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu cho Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đa-vít tuyên bố: "Đây là nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, và đây là bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu cho Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.R: Bấy giờ Đa-vít nói: "Nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ở tại đây, và đây sẽ là bàn thờ nơi Y-sơ-ra-ên dâng các của lễ thiêu."

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 말했다. "이것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님의 집이요, 이것이 이스라엘의 번제단[이다]."
ko.B: 그때 다윗이 선언했다. "여기가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님의 집이고, 여기가 이스라엘이 번제를 드릴 제단이다."
ko.R: 그때 다윗이 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님의 성전이 여기에 세워질 것이다. 그리고 이스라엘이 번제를 드릴 제단도 여기에 있을 것이다."

decisions.choice: this is the house of the LORD God: this place is where God's house is to stand
alternatives: this is the house of the LORD God (the building already present)
decisions.reason: David speaks at the threshing floor of Ornan, where he had built an altar and the LORD answered him with fire from heaven (21:18-28). No building stands there yet; David declares the spot to be the site of the house and its altar. 2 Chronicles 3:1 says Solomon built the house there, on Mount Moriah. The verse closes the story of chapter 21 and opens the account of David's preparations.

decisions.choice: the LORD God: the divine name joined to "the God"
decisions.reason: The divine name is followed by "the God", a rare pairing that stresses that the LORD is the one true God. Verse 19 uses it again for the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: will be here; this will be the altar where Israel offers burnt offerings
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that David is naming the site of a house still to be built (m1), and spells out "altar of burnt offering for Israel" as the place where the people's offerings will be made.

decisions.choice: "la maison du SEIGNEUR" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Kings terms note uses "le temple" at Readable; here David names a house not yet built and the place itself, so Readable keeps "maison" in this verse, as the English Readable keeps "house". From verse 6 on, Readable says "temple" where the English does.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님의 집" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님의 성전" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's "주의 집" (L, B) and "주의 성전" (R) for the house of the LORD, held through chapters 22-29; here with "하나님", as Chronicles has "Yahweh God".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד לִכְנוֹס֙ אֶת־הַגֵּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד חֹֽצְבִ֗ים לַחְצוֹב֙ אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֔ית לִבְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said David to gather the sojourners who [were] in [the] land of Israel; and he appointed stonecutters to cut stones of hewn [stone] to build [the] house of the God.

en.L: And David said to gather the sojourners who [were] in the land of Israel, and he appointed stonecutters to cut dressed stones to build the house of God.
en.B: So David gave orders to gather the outsiders who were living in the land of Israel, and he set stonecutters to cut dressed stones for building the house of God.
en.R: So David ordered that the outsiders living in the land of Israel be brought together. These were people who were not Israelites. He put some of them to work as stonecutters, shaping blocks of stone to build God's house.

es.L: Y dijo David que se reuniera a los inmigrantes que [había] en la tierra de Israel; y puso canteros para labrar piedras talladas para edificar la casa de Dios.
es.B: Así que David dio orden de reunir a los extranjeros que vivían en la tierra de Israel, y puso canteros a labrar piedras talladas para edificar la casa de Dios.
es.R: Así que David ordenó que se reuniera a los extranjeros que vivían en la tierra de Israel. Eran personas que no eran israelitas. A algunos de ellos los puso a trabajar como canteros, dándoles forma a bloques de piedra para construir la casa de Dios.

fr.L: Et David dit de rassembler les immigrés qui [étaient] dans le pays d’Israël, et il établit des tailleurs de pierre pour tailler des pierres de taille pour bâtir la maison de Dieu.
fr.B: David ordonna donc de rassembler les étrangers qui vivaient dans le pays d’Israël, et il chargea des tailleurs de pierre de tailler des pierres pour bâtir la maison de Dieu.
fr.R: David a donc ordonné de réunir les étrangers qui vivaient dans le pays d’Israël. C’étaient des gens qui n’étaient pas israélites. Il a mis certains d’entre eux au travail comme tailleurs de pierre, pour préparer des blocs de pierre afin de bâtir la maison de Dieu.

sw.L: Daudi akasema kuwakusanya wageni waliokuwa katika nchi ya Israeli, akaweka wachonga mawe kuchonga mawe yaliyochongwa ili kujenga nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.B: Basi Daudi akaagiza wakusanywe wageni waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ya Israeli, akaweka wachonga mawe kuchonga mawe kwa ajili ya kujenga nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.R: Basi Daudi akaagiza wageni walioishi katika nchi ya Israeli wakusanywe. Hao walikuwa watu wasio Waisraeli. Akawaweka baadhi yao kufanya kazi ya kuchonga mawe, wakitengeneza matofali ya mawe kwa ajili ya kujenga nyumba ya Mungu.

vi.L: Đa-vít truyền tập họp các ngoại kiều trong xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên, và ông lập thợ đẽo đá để đẽo đá vuông mà xây nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Vậy Đa-vít ra lệnh tập họp những người ngoại kiều sống trong xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên, và ông giao cho thợ đẽo đá đẽo những tảng đá vuông để xây nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Vậy Đa-vít ra lệnh tập họp những người ngoại kiều sống trong xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên. Đó là những người không thuộc dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông cho một số người trong họ làm thợ đẽo đá, đẽo những khối đá để xây nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 이스라엘 땅에 있는 나그네들을 모으라고 말하고, 하나님의 집을 짓기 위해 다듬은 돌을 떠내도록 석수들을 세웠다.
ko.B: 그래서 다윗은 이스라엘 땅에 사는 이방인들을 모으라고 명령하고, 하나님의 집을 짓는 데 쓸 다듬은 돌을 떠내도록 석수들을 세웠다.
ko.R: 그래서 다윗은 이스라엘 땅에 사는 이방인들을 불러 모으라고 명령했다. 그들은 이스라엘 사람이 아닌 사람들이었다. 다윗은 그들 가운데 몇 사람에게 돌 다듬는 일을 맡겨, 하나님의 성전을 지을 돌을 다듬게 했다.

decisions.choice: said to gather: gave orders to gather
decisions.reason: The verb "say" followed by an infinitive is a king's command, as in 15:16 and 21:17.

decisions.choice: the sojourners: people of non-Israelite descent living in Israel
decisions.reason: A sojourner was someone living among Israel without being an Israelite by birth, with some protection under the law but no inherited land. Solomon later counted such people and set them to work as stonecutters and carriers (2 Chronicles 2:16-17; compare 1 Kings 9:20-22). The stonecutters David appoints here are most likely drawn from them.

decisions.choice: dressed stones: blocks cut and squared for building
decisions.reason: The noun names stone cut to shape with tools, as for the foundations of the temple (1 Kings 5:31) and the palace (1 Kings 7:9); Exodus 20:25 forbade such stone for an altar, but not for a house.

decisions.choice: These were people who were not Israelites. He put some of them to work as stonecutters
decisions.reason: Readable explains "outsiders" (m2) and shows that the workers came from them, which the context implies (2 Chronicles 2:16-17).

decisions.choice: inmigrantes (L); extranjeros (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word *ger* as in the Spanish of Samuel and the Pentateuch: "inmigrante" at Literal, "extranjero" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: wageni
decisions.reason: The *gerim* are "wageni", the Pentateuch's word for foreigners living in the land; Readable adds that they were not Israelites, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "나그네들" (L); "이방인들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional word for the *ger*, the outsider living in the land; Balanced and Readable name them as non-Israelites, as the English moves from "sojourners" to "outsiders".

source.text: וּבַרְזֶ֣ל׀לָ֠רֹב לַֽמִּסְמְרִ֞ים לְדַלְת֧וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֛ים וְלַֽמְחַבְּר֖וֹת הֵכִ֣ין דָּוִ֑יד וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת לָרֹ֖ב אֵ֥ין מִשְׁקָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And iron in abundance for the nails for [the] doors of the gates and for the clamps prepared David, and bronze in abundance, there [was] no weight.

en.L: And iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the clamps David prepared, and bronze in abundance, without weight.
en.B: David provided a great deal of iron for nails for the doors of the gates and for clamps, and more bronze than could be weighed.
en.R: David got ready large amounts of iron to make nails for the gate doors and clamps to hold the building together. He also gathered so much bronze that no one could weigh it.

es.L: Y hierro en abundancia para los clavos de las puertas de las entradas y para las grapas preparó David, y bronce en abundancia, sin peso.
es.B: David proveyó mucho hierro para los clavos de las hojas de las puertas y para las grapas, y más bronce del que se podía pesar.
es.R: David preparó grandes cantidades de hierro para hacer clavos para las puertas y grapas para unir las partes del edificio. También reunió tanto bronce que nadie podía pesarlo.

fr.L: Et du fer en abondance pour les clous des battants des portes et pour les crampons, David [le] prépara, et du bronze en abondance, sans poids.
fr.B: David prépara aussi du fer en grande quantité pour les clous des battants des portes et pour les crampons, et plus de bronze qu’on ne pouvait en peser.
fr.R: David a préparé de grandes quantités de fer pour faire des clous pour les portes et des crampons pour tenir le bâtiment ensemble. Il a aussi rassemblé tant de bronze que personne ne pouvait le peser.

sw.L: Daudi akaandaa chuma kwa wingi kwa ajili ya misumari ya milango ya malango na kwa ajili ya vifungo, na shaba kwa wingi, bila kupimwa uzito.
sw.B: Daudi aliandaa chuma kingi kwa ajili ya misumari ya milango ya malango na kwa ajili ya vifungo, na shaba nyingi kuliko ingeweza kupimwa.
sw.R: Daudi aliandaa chuma kingi cha kutengeneza misumari ya milango ya malango na vifungo vya kuushikanisha ujenzi. Akakusanya pia shaba nyingi sana hata hakuna mtu aliyeweza kuipima.

vi.L: Đa-vít chuẩn bị nhiều sắt để làm đinh cho các cánh cửa của các cổng và để làm móc nối, và rất nhiều đồng, không thể cân được.
vi.B: Đa-vít chuẩn bị rất nhiều sắt để làm đinh cho các cánh cổng và làm móc nối, cùng với nhiều đồng đến nỗi không thể cân được.
vi.R: Đa-vít chuẩn bị rất nhiều sắt để làm đinh cho các cánh cổng và làm móc nối để giữ các phần của công trình với nhau. Ông cũng thu góp nhiều đồng đến nỗi không ai cân được.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 성문들의 문짝에 쓸 못과 꺾쇠를 위해 철을 많이 마련했고, 놋쇠도 무게를 달 수 없을 만큼 많이 [마련했다].
ko.B: 다윗은 성문들의 문짝에 쓸 못과 꺾쇠를 만들 철을 많이 마련했고, 놋쇠도 무게를 달 수 없을 만큼 많이 마련했다.
ko.R: 다윗은 성문 문짝에 쓸 못과 건물을 단단히 잡아 줄 꺾쇠를 만들려고 철을 많이 준비했다. 또 놋쇠도 무게를 달 수 없을 만큼 많이 모았다.

decisions.choice: prepared: laid up in advance, provided
decisions.reason: The verb means to make ready or set in place. It is the key word of the chapter (verses 3, 5 and 14): David cannot build the house, but he readies everything for it.

decisions.choice: clamps: fittings that join parts of a structure
decisions.reason: The word comes from a root meaning "join". 2 Chronicles 34:11 uses it of timbers for joining a building; here they are of iron, so metal fastenings or couplings are meant.

decisions.choice: there was no weight: too much to weigh
decisions.reason: A way of saying the amount was beyond measuring, used of the bronze for Solomon's temple too (1 Kings 7:47).

decisions.choice: clamps to hold the building together
decisions.reason: Readable says what the clamps were for, in line with m2.

source.text: וַעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים לְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּֽי הֵ֠בִיאוּ הַצִּֽידֹנִ֨ים וְהַצֹּרִ֜ים עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים לָרֹ֖ב לְדָוִֽיד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And wood of cedars without number, for brought the Sidonians and the Tyrians wood of cedars in abundance to David.

en.L: And cedar logs without number, for the Sidonians and the Tyrians brought cedar logs in abundance to David.
en.B: There were also cedar logs beyond counting, for the Sidonians and the Tyrians had brought great quantities of cedar to David.
en.R: There were also more cedar logs than anyone could count, because the people of the cities of Sidon and Tyre had brought David great amounts of cedar wood.

es.L: Y madera de cedro sin número, porque los sidonios y los tirios traían madera de cedro en abundancia a David.
es.B: También había troncos de cedro sin número, porque los sidonios y los tirios le habían traído a David grandes cantidades de cedro.
es.R: También había más troncos de cedro de los que nadie podía contar, porque la gente de las ciudades de Sidón y Tiro le había traído a David grandes cantidades de madera de cedro.

fr.L: Et des bois de cèdre sans nombre, car les Sidoniens et les Tyriens apportaient du bois de cèdre en abondance à David.
fr.B: Il y avait aussi du bois de cèdre en quantité innombrable, car les Sidoniens et les Tyriens avaient apporté à David du cèdre en abondance.
fr.R: Il y avait aussi plus de troncs de cèdre qu’on ne pouvait en compter, parce que les habitants des villes de Sidon et de Tyr avaient apporté à David de grandes quantités de bois de cèdre.

sw.L: Na magogo ya mierezi yasiyo na hesabu, kwa maana Wasidoni na Watiro walimletea Daudi magogo ya mierezi kwa wingi.
sw.B: Pia kulikuwa na magogo ya mierezi yasiyohesabika, kwa maana Wasidoni na Watiro walikuwa wamemletea Daudi mierezi mingi sana.
sw.R: Pia kulikuwa na magogo ya mierezi mengi kuliko mtu yeyote angeweza kuhesabu, kwa sababu watu wa miji ya Sidoni na Tiro walikuwa wamemletea Daudi mbao nyingi za mierezi.

vi.L: Và gỗ bá hương nhiều vô số, vì người Si-đôn và người Ty-rơ đã chở rất nhiều gỗ bá hương đến cho Đa-vít.
vi.B: Cũng có gỗ bá hương nhiều không đếm xuể, vì người Si-đôn và người Ty-rơ đã chở đến cho Đa-vít rất nhiều gỗ bá hương.
vi.R: Cũng có nhiều gỗ bá hương đến nỗi không ai đếm được, vì dân các thành Si-đôn và Ty-rơ đã chở đến cho Đa-vít rất nhiều gỗ bá hương.

ko.L: 그리고 백향목도 셀 수 없이 [많았다]. 시돈 사람들과 두로 사람들이 다윗에게 백향목을 많이 가져왔기 때문이다.
ko.B: 백향목도 셀 수 없이 많았다. 시돈 사람들과 두로 사람들이 다윗에게 백향목을 많이 가져다주었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 백향목도 아무도 셀 수 없을 만큼 많았다. 시돈 성과 두로 성 사람들이 다윗에게 백향목을 아주 많이 가져다주었기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: Sidonians and Tyrians: the people of the Phoenician coastal cities who traded in cedar
decisions.reason: Sidon and Tyre lay on the coast north of Israel, near the cedar forests of Lebanon. Hiram king of Tyre had sent cedar for David's palace (14:1; 2 Samuel 5:11), and later supplied Solomon (1 Kings 5:20-24, where the Sidonians are named as skilled at cutting timber).

decisions.choice: for they had brought: the reason the cedar was so plentiful
decisions.reason: The clause explains the supply; the bringing came before David's preparations were complete.

decisions.choice: without number: more than could be counted
decisions.reason: Like "no weight" in verse 3, a way of stressing a vast amount.

decisions.choice: the people of the cities of Sidon and Tyre
decisions.reason: Readable names the cities so that young readers know who the Sidonians and Tyrians were.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִי֮ נַ֣עַר וָרָךְ֒ וְהַבַּ֜יִת לִבְנ֣וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְהַגְדִּ֨יל׀לְמַ֜עְלָה לְשֵׁ֤ם וּלְתִפְאֶ֨רֶת֙ לְכָל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אָכִ֥ינָה נָּ֖א ל֑וֹ וַיָּ֧כֶן דָּוִ֛יד לָרֹ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said David, Solomon my son [is] young and tender, and the house to build for Yahweh [is] to make great upward, for a name and for splendor to all the lands; let me prepare, please, for it. And prepared David in abundance before his death.

en.L: And David said, "Solomon my son [is] young and tender, and the house to be built for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] to be made exceedingly great, for a name and for splendor to all the lands. Let me prepare for it." And David prepared in abundance before his death.
en.B: David said, "Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and the house that is to be built for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} must be made great beyond measure, so that its fame and splendor reach all lands. So let me get things ready for it." So before his death David laid up materials in great quantity.
en.R: David said, "My son Solomon is young and has little experience. But the house built for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} must be very great. It must be famous and beautiful in every country. So I will get things ready for it." So David got a great amount of materials ready before he died.

es.L: Y dijo David: «Salomón mi hijo [es] joven y tierno, y la casa que se ha de edificar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} [ha de ser] grande en extremo, para nombre y para gloria en todas las tierras. Prepararé, pues, para ella». Y preparó David en abundancia antes de su muerte.
es.B: David dijo: «Mi hijo Salomón es joven y sin experiencia, y la casa que se ha de edificar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tiene que ser grandiosa en extremo, para que su fama y su esplendor lleguen a todas las tierras. Por eso dejaré preparadas las cosas para ella». Así que antes de morir David reunió materiales en gran cantidad.
es.R: David dijo: «Mi hijo Salomón es joven y tiene poca experiencia. Pero la casa que se construya {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tiene que ser muy grande. Tiene que ser famosa y hermosa en todos los países. Por eso yo dejaré listas las cosas para ella». Así que antes de morir David dejó lista una gran cantidad de materiales.

fr.L: Et David dit : « Salomon mon fils [est] jeune et tendre, et la maison à bâtir pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [doit être] magnifiée à l’extrême, pour [avoir] un nom et une splendeur dans tous les pays ; je veux donc préparer pour elle. » Et David prépara en abondance avant sa mort.
fr.B: David se disait : « Mon fils Salomon est jeune et sans expérience, et la maison qu’il faut bâtir pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} doit être d’une grandeur extraordinaire, pour que sa renommée et sa splendeur atteignent tous les pays. Je vais donc tout préparer pour elle. » Ainsi, avant sa mort, David amassa des matériaux en grande quantité.
fr.R: David a dit : « Mon fils Salomon est jeune et il n’a pas beaucoup d’expérience. Mais la maison qu’on bâtira pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} doit être très grande. Elle doit être célèbre et admirée dans tous les pays. Alors je vais tout préparer pour elle. » David a donc préparé une grande quantité de matériaux avant de mourir.

sw.L: Daudi akasema, "Sulemani mwanangu [ni] kijana na mchanga, na nyumba itakayojengwa kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] ya kufanywa kuu mno, kwa jina na kwa fahari katika nchi zote. Na niiandalie." Daudi akaandaa kwa wingi kabla ya kifo chake.
sw.B: Daudi akasema, "Sulemani mwanangu ni kijana na hana uzoefu, na nyumba itakayojengwa kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lazima iwe kuu kupita kiasi, ili sifa zake na fahari yake zifike katika nchi zote. Basi na niiandalie mahitaji yake." Kwa hiyo kabla ya kifo chake Daudi aliweka akiba ya vifaa vingi sana.
sw.R: Daudi akasema, "Mwanangu Sulemani ni kijana, naye hana uzoefu mwingi. Lakini nyumba itakayojengwa kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lazima iwe kuu sana. Lazima ijulikane na kuonekana nzuri katika kila nchi. Kwa hiyo nitaandaa mahitaji yake." Basi Daudi akaandaa vifaa vingi sana kabla hajafa.

vi.L: Đa-vít nói: "Sa-lô-môn con ta còn trẻ và non nớt, mà ngôi nhà sẽ xây cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phải hết sức vĩ đại, để có danh tiếng và vẻ huy hoàng khắp mọi xứ. Vậy ta sẽ chuẩn bị cho nhà ấy." Vậy Đa-vít chuẩn bị thật nhiều trước khi qua đời.
vi.B: Đa-vít nói: "Sa-lô-môn con ta còn trẻ và thiếu kinh nghiệm, mà ngôi nhà sẽ xây cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phải vĩ đại vô cùng, để danh tiếng và vẻ huy hoàng của nó lan khắp mọi xứ. Vậy ta sẽ chuẩn bị sẵn cho nhà ấy." Vậy trước khi qua đời, Đa-vít đã chuẩn bị vật liệu rất nhiều.
vi.R: Đa-vít nói: "Sa-lô-môn con ta còn trẻ và ít kinh nghiệm. Nhưng ngôi nhà xây cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phải thật vĩ đại. Nó phải nổi tiếng và đẹp đẽ trong mọi xứ. Vậy ta sẽ chuẩn bị sẵn cho nhà ấy." Vậy Đa-vít chuẩn bị rất nhiều vật liệu trước khi qua đời.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 말했다. "내 아들 솔로몬은 어리고 연약하다. 그런데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 지을 집은 모든 나라에 이름과 영광이 [나도록] 매우 크게 지어야 한다. 그러니 내가 그것을 위해 준비하겠다." 그리고 다윗이 죽기 전에 많이 준비했다.

ko.R: 다윗이 말했다. "내 아들 솔로몬은 어리고 경험이 부족하다. 그런데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위해 지을 성전은 아주 웅장해야 한다. 모든 나라에 그 이름이 알려지고 그 아름다움이 널리 퍼져야 한다. 그러니 내가 그것을 위해 준비해 두겠다." 그래서 다윗은 죽기 전에 재료를 많이 준비해 두었다.

decisions.choice: young and tender: young and inexperienced
decisions.reason: "Tender" (soft) describes someone not yet hardened by experience. David says the same of Solomon in 29:1. He is old enough to be made king (23:1), so the words do not mean a small child; compare Solomon's own humble words in 1 Kings 3:7.

decisions.choice: to make great upward: to make very great, to the highest degree
decisions.reason: "Upward" after "make great" is a way of saying "exceedingly". The house must be on a scale fit for the LORD.

decisions.choice: for a name and for splendor to all the lands: so that the house is renowned and admired in every land
decisions.reason: "Name" here means renown. The aim is that the house be known and honored among all nations, which brings honor to the LORD it is built for (compare 1 Kings 8:41-43).

decisions.choice: let me prepare for it: David's resolve
decisions.reason: The verb has the form of a wish or resolve, strengthened by the particle "please": since Solomon is young, David decides to do the preparing himself.

decisions.choice: laid up materials in great quantity / got a great amount of materials ready
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says David "prepared in abundance" without naming an object; verses 2-4 and 14 show it was building materials, and Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "David se disait"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "said" here introduces a resolve with no one addressed, so Balanced uses French "se dire" for what David decided; Literal and Readable keep "dit".

decisions.choice: commanded him: gave him a solemn charge
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a father's or leader's last instructions, as David charges Solomon in 1 Kings 2:1 and Moses charges Joshua in Deuteronomy 31:23. Verses 7-16 give the words of the charge.

decisions.choice: a house for the LORD: a temple
decisions.reason: "House" is the usual word for a temple, the place where God's presence dwells among his people.

decisions.choice: David; temple
decisions.reason: Readable names David as the subject and says "temple" for "house", as Readable does through the chapter.

decisions.choice: hekalu (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets, the house of the LORD is "nyumba" at Literal and Balanced and "hekalu" (temple) at Readable.

vi.B: Đa-vít nói với Sa-lô-môn: "Con ơi, chính cha đã ao ước xây một ngôi nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của cha.
vi.R: Đa-vít nói với Sa-lô-môn: "Con ơi, cha đã muốn xây một đền thờ để tôn vinh danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của cha.

ko.B: 다윗이 솔로몬에게 말했다. "내 아들아, 나는 내 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 집을 짓고 싶은 마음이 있었다.

decisions.choice: my son (the form read aloud)
alternatives: David said to Solomon his son
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text spell "his son", which would make the words part of the narration ("David said to Solomon his son"); the scribes' marginal note directs that it be read "my son", which makes it the opening of David's speech. The data follows the reading, and the sense hardly changes.

decisions.choice: it was with my heart: I intended, I wished
decisions.reason: To have something "with" or "in" one's heart is to plan or desire it, as David's wish to build is told in 17:1-2 and 28:2 (compare 1 Kings 8:17).

decisions.choice: a house for the name of the LORD: the place where the LORD makes himself known and is called on
decisions.reason: The "name" stands for the LORD himself as he reveals himself to his people. Deuteronomy 12:5 and 11 speak of the place he will choose "to put his name there", and Solomon's prayer returns to it (1 Kings 8:29).

decisions.choice: I: placed first for emphasis
decisions.reason: The pronoun stands at the front: "I, for my part". David sets his own wish against what the LORD said, which follows in verse 8.

decisions.choice: a temple to honor the name
decisions.reason: Readable explains "a house for the name" in line with m3, as 2 Samuel 7:13 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: David says "cha" for himself and "con" to Solomon
decisions.reason: The Genesis note's forms for a parent speaking to a child, as the Vietnamese 1 Kings 2 has David speak to Solomon.

decisions.choice: David speaks to Solomon in 해라체 with "내 아들아"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis note for parent and child and the Samuel note's address to a son; David's long charge (verses 7-16) keeps this style throughout.

records.literal_gloss: And came to me [the] word of Yahweh, saying, Blood in abundance you have shed, and wars great you have made; not you will build a house for my name, for bloods much you have shed to the earth before me.

en.L: But the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me, saying, 'Blood in abundance you have shed, and great wars you have waged. You shall not build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, for much blood you have shed on the earth before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: But the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me: 'You have poured out blood in great amounts and waged great wars. You will not build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, because of all the blood you have poured out on the earth in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave me this message: 'You have killed many people and fought great wars. So you will not be the one to build a temple for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. You have spilled so much blood on the earth in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Pero vino a mí la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, diciendo: ‘Sangre en abundancia has derramado, y grandes guerras has hecho. No edificarás casa a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, porque mucha sangre has derramado en la tierra delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Pero la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a mí: ‘Has derramado sangre en abundancia y has hecho grandes guerras. No edificarás una casa para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, por toda la sangre que has derramado en la tierra en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio este mensaje: ‘Has matado a mucha gente y has peleado grandes guerras. Por eso no serás tú quien construya un templo para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Has derramado mucha sangre en la tierra delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Mais la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée, en disant : “Tu as versé du sang en abondance, et tu as fait de grandes guerres. Tu ne bâtiras pas de maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, car tu as versé beaucoup de sang sur la terre devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Mais la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée : “Tu as répandu le sang en grande quantité et tu as mené de grandes guerres. Tu ne bâtiras pas de maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, à cause de tout le sang que tu as répandu sur la terre en {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} présence.
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné ce message : “Tu as tué beaucoup de gens et tu as fait de grandes guerres. Alors ce n’est pas toi qui construiras un temple pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Tu as fait couler trop de sang sur la terre devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Lakini neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likanijia, kusema, 'Umemwaga damu kwa wingi, na umepigana vita vikubwa. Hutajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, kwa maana umemwaga damu nyingi juu ya nchi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Lakini neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likanijia: 'Umemwaga damu nyingi sana na kupigana vita vikubwa. Hutajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, kwa sababu ya damu yote uliyoimwaga juu ya nchi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanipa ujumbe huu: 'Umeua watu wengi na kupigana vita vikubwa. Kwa hiyo wewe hutakuwa ndiye wa kujenga hekalu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Umemwaga damu nyingi sana juu ya nchi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Nhưng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với cha rằng: 'Ngươi đã làm đổ máu nhiều, và đã đánh những trận lớn. Ngươi sẽ không xây nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì ngươi đã làm đổ nhiều máu trên đất trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Nhưng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với cha: 'Con đã làm đổ máu rất nhiều và đã đánh những trận lớn. Con sẽ không xây nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì con đã làm đổ quá nhiều máu trên đất trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với cha: 'Con đã giết nhiều người và đánh những trận lớn. Vì vậy con sẽ không phải là người xây đền thờ cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Con đã làm đổ quá nhiều máu trên đất trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임하여 말씀하셨다. '너는 피를 많이 흘렸고 큰 전쟁들을 치렀다. 너는 내 이름을 위하여 집을 짓지 못할 것이다. 네가 내 앞에서 땅에 많은 피를 흘렸기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그런데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임했다. '너는 피를 많이 흘렸고 큰 전쟁을 많이 치렀다. 너는 내 이름을 위하여 집을 짓지 못할 것이다. 네가 내 앞에서 땅에 그토록 많은 피를 흘렸기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그런데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. '너는 많은 사람을 죽였고 큰 전쟁들을 치렀다. 그러니 내 이름을 높이는 성전을 지을 사람은 네가 아니다. 너는 내 앞에서 땅에 너무 많은 피를 흘렸다.

decisions.choice: David may not build the house because he has shed much blood in war
alternatives: the bloodshed counts as guilt against David
David was only prevented by being busy with war (1 Kings 5:17)
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives a reason the earlier books do not. In 2 Samuel 7:5-13 (1 Chronicles 17:4-12) the LORD simply says that he will build David a house and that David's son will build the house for his name. In 1 Kings 5:17 Solomon says David could not build because wars surrounded him on every side and kept him busy. Here (and in 28:3) the wars themselves make David unfit to build the house. His wars were fought with the LORD's help (18:6, 13), so this is not a verdict that they were wicked; rather, the house of rest is to be built by a man of rest and peace (verse 9), not by a warrior whose hands are marked by killing.

decisions.choice: shed blood: take human life, here in battle
decisions.reason: "Pour out blood" means to kill. The plural "bloods" in the second clause stresses many deaths.

decisions.choice: on the earth before me: on the ground, in the LORD's sight
decisions.reason: The blood soaks into the ground (compare Genesis 4:10-11; Deuteronomy 12:16), and the LORD has seen all of it.

decisions.choice: saying: introduces the LORD's own words
decisions.reason: David now quotes the word he received. The quotation runs to the end of verse 10; verse 11 is David speaking again. This word is not found in 1 Chronicles 17 or 2 Samuel 7.

decisions.choice: killed many people
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom "shed blood" (m2) the first time, then keeps "spilled blood" so the picture of verse 8b remains.

decisions.choice: “ ” for the LORD’s words inside David’s speech
decisions.reason: A quotation inside « » takes “ ” in French, as the French style guide sets; the quoted word runs to the end of verse 10.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 나에게 임하여 말씀하셨다" (L), "임했다" (B), "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's formula for "the word of the LORD came to X".

source.text: הִנֵּה־בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֣ד לָ֗ךְ ה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְנוּחָ֔ה וַהֲנִח֥וֹתִי ל֛וֹ מִכָּל־אוֹיְבָ֖יו מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔וֹ וְשָׁל֥וֹם וָשֶׁ֛קֶט אֶתֵּ֥ן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּיָמָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Here, a son [will be] born to you; he will be a man of rest, and I will give rest to him from all his enemies from round about; for Solomon will be his name, and peace and quietness I will give on Israel in his days.

en.L: Look, a son [is to be] born to you. He will be a man of rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for Solomon will be his name, and peace and quiet I will give to Israel in his days.
en.B: Look, a son is to be born to you, and he will be a man of rest. I will grant him rest from all the enemies around him. For his name will be Solomon, and in his days I will give Israel peace and quiet.
en.R: Look, a son will be born to you. He will be a man of rest. I will let him live at rest, free from all the enemies around him. His name will be Solomon, a name that sounds like the word for peace, and while he lives I will give Israel peace and quiet.

es.L: He aquí, te nacerá un hijo; él será hombre de reposo, y yo le daré reposo de todos sus enemigos alrededor; porque Salomón será su nombre, y paz y tranquilidad daré a Israel en sus días.
es.B: Mira, te nacerá un hijo, y él será un hombre de reposo. Yo le daré reposo de todos los enemigos que lo rodean. Su nombre será Salomón, y en sus días daré a Israel paz y tranquilidad.
es.R: Mira, te nacerá un hijo. Él será un hombre de reposo. Haré que viva en reposo, libre de todos los enemigos que lo rodean. Su nombre será Salomón, un nombre que suena como la palabra «paz», y mientras él viva daré a Israel paz y tranquilidad.

fr.L: Voici, un fils te [naîtra] ; lui sera un homme de repos, et je lui donnerai du repos face à tous ses ennemis d’alentour ; car Salomon sera son nom, et je donnerai paix et tranquillité à Israël pendant ses jours.
fr.B: Voici, un fils va te naître, et ce sera un homme de repos. Je lui donnerai du repos face à tous les ennemis qui l’entourent. Car son nom sera Salomon, et pendant son règne je donnerai à Israël la paix et la tranquillité.
fr.R: Écoute bien : tu vas avoir un fils. Ce sera un homme de repos. Je le laisserai vivre en paix, à l’abri de tous les ennemis qui l’entourent. Son nom sera Salomon, un nom qui ressemble au mot « paix », et pendant toute sa vie je donnerai à Israël la paix et la tranquillité.

sw.L: Tazama, mwana [atazaliwa] kwako. Yeye atakuwa mtu wa raha, nami nitampa raha kutoka kwa adui zake wote pande zote; kwa maana jina lake litakuwa Sulemani, nami nitawapa Israeli amani na utulivu katika siku zake.
sw.B: Tazama, utazaliwa mwana, naye atakuwa mtu wa raha. Nitampa raha kutoka kwa adui zake wote wanaomzunguka. Kwa maana jina lake litakuwa Sulemani, nami nitawapa Israeli amani na utulivu katika siku zake.
sw.R: Tazama, utapata mwana. Yeye atakuwa mtu wa raha. Nitamwezesha kuishi kwa raha, bila adui wote wanaomzunguka. Jina lake litakuwa Sulemani, jina linalofanana na neno la Kiebrania la amani, na wakati wa maisha yake nitawapa Israeli amani na utulivu.

vi.L: Kìa, một con trai [sẽ] sinh ra cho ngươi. Người sẽ là người của sự yên nghỉ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho người được yên nghỉ khỏi mọi kẻ thù chung quanh; vì Sa-lô-môn sẽ là tên người, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban bình an và yên tĩnh cho Y-sơ-ra-ên trong đời người.
vi.B: Kìa, con sẽ có một con trai, và người sẽ là người của sự yên nghỉ. Ta sẽ cho người được yên nghỉ khỏi mọi kẻ thù chung quanh. Vì tên người sẽ là Sa-lô-môn, và trong đời người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên bình an và yên tĩnh.
vi.R: Kìa, con sẽ có một con trai. Người sẽ là người của sự yên nghỉ. Ta sẽ cho người được sống yên ổn, không còn kẻ thù chung quanh. Tên người sẽ là Sa-lô-môn, là tên nghe giống chữ "bình an", và trong suốt đời người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên bình an và yên tĩnh.

ko.L: 보아라, 너에게 아들이 태어날 것이다. 그는 안식의 사람이 될 것이다. 내가 그에게 사방의 모든 원수에게서 안식을 주겠다. 그의 이름이 솔로몬이 될 것이며, 그의 날에 내가 이스라엘에게 평화와 안정을 주겠다.
ko.B: 보아라, 너에게 아들이 태어날 것이다. 그는 평안을 누리는 사람이 될 것이다. 내가 그를 둘러싼 모든 원수에게서 그를 평안하게 하겠다. 그의 이름은 솔로몬이 될 것이며, 그가 사는 동안 내가 이스라엘에게 평화와 안정을 주겠다.
ko.R: 보아라, 너에게 아들이 태어날 것이다. 그는 평안을 누리는 사람이 될 것이다. 그를 둘러싼 원수들이 그를 괴롭히지 못하게 하겠다. 그의 이름은 솔로몬이 될 것이다. 솔로몬은 '평화'라는 말과 소리가 비슷한 이름이다. 그가 사는 동안 내가 이스라엘에게 평화와 안정을 주겠다.

decisions.choice: Solomon ... peace: a play on the name
decisions.reason: The name Solomon (Shelomo) sounds like the word for peace (shalom), and the LORD links them: "Solomon will be his name, and peace ... I will give." The name is read as a sign of what his reign will bring. 2 Samuel 12:24-25 says the LORD also gave him the name Jedidiah, "loved by the LORD".

decisions.choice: a man of rest; I will give him rest: freedom from war and enemies
decisions.reason: "Rest" (menuchah) here is safety from enemies, a settled peace in the land. The LORD had promised such rest as the time when the place for his name would be chosen (Deuteronomy 12:10-11), and Solomon later says that rest has come (1 Kings 5:18). The noun and the verb share a root: the man of rest is given rest. Verse 18 takes up the same verb.

decisions.choice: a son will be born to you: a promise about the future
alternatives: a son has been born to you
decisions.reason: The participle points ahead to a birth still to come, from the time the word was given.

decisions.choice: peace and quiet: security and calm in the land
decisions.reason: "Quiet" is the word used in Judges for the land at rest from war (Judges 3:11); together with "peace" it describes a reign free of war.

decisions.choice: a name that sounds like the word for peace
decisions.reason: Readable explains the wordplay (m1), which is lost in translation.

decisions.choice: un nombre que suena como la palabra «paz»
decisions.reason: Readable explains the play on Solomon's name and the Hebrew word for peace; Spanish "Salomón" and "paz" do not sound alike, so the explanation is needed as in English.

decisions.choice: jina linalofanana na neno la Kiebrania la amani
alternatives: a name that sounds like the word for peace
decisions.reason: The play on Solomon's name and *shalom* does not carry into Swahili, so Readable says that the name sounds like the Hebrew word for peace.

decisions.choice: "là tên nghe giống chữ 'bình an'"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the play on Solomon's name and *shalom* is explained; Vietnamese cannot keep the sound.

decisions.choice: "솔로몬은 '평화'라는 말과 소리가 비슷한 이름이다"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the wordplay between Solomon and *shalom*, as the English Readable does; Korean "평화" is the word the verse uses for the peace.

source.text: הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י וְהוּא֙ יִהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִי־ל֖וֹ לְאָ֑ב וַהֲכִ֨ינוֹתִ֜י כִּסֵּ֧א מַלְכוּת֛וֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: He will build a house for my name, and he will be to me for a son, and I to him for a father; and I will establish [the] throne of his kingdom over Israel until forever.

en.L: He will build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and he will be to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a son, and I [will be] to him a father, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.'
en.B: He is the one who will build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. He will be a son to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will be a father to him, and I will make the throne of his kingdom over Israel firm forever.'
en.R: He is the one who will build a house to be a temple that honors {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. He will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} son, and I will be his father. And I will make sure that his throne as king over Israel will last forever.'

es.L: Él edificará una casa a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y él será para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} hijo, y yo [seré] para él padre, y afirmaré el trono de su reino sobre Israel para siempre’.
es.B: Él es quien edificará una casa para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Él será un hijo para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo seré un padre para él, y haré firme para siempre el trono de su reino sobre Israel’.
es.R: Él es quien construirá una casa que será un templo para honrar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Él será {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hijo, y yo seré su padre. Y haré que su trono como rey sobre Israel dure para siempre’.

fr.L: C’est lui qui bâtira une maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et lui sera pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un fils, et moi [je serai] pour lui un père, et j’affermirai le trône de sa royauté sur Israël pour toujours.”
fr.B: C’est lui qui bâtira une maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Il sera pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un fils, et je serai pour lui un père, et j’affermirai pour toujours le trône de son royaume sur Israël.”
fr.R: C’est lui qui construira une maison, un temple pour honorer {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Il sera {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} fils, et je serai son père. Et je ferai en sorte que son trône de roi d’Israël dure pour toujours.”

sw.L: Yeye atajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, naye atakuwa kwangu mwana, nami [nitakuwa] kwake baba, nami nitakiimarisha kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wake juu ya Israeli milele.'
sw.B: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Yeye atakuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake, nami nitakiimarisha kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wake juu ya Israeli milele.'
sw.R: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba, yaani hekalu la kuliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Yeye atakuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake. Nami nitahakikisha kwamba kiti chake cha enzi kama mfalme juu ya Israeli kitadumu milele.'

vi.L: Chính người ấy sẽ xây một nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, người sẽ làm con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [sẽ] làm cha người, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập vững ngai vương quốc người trên Y-sơ-ra-ên đến đời đời.'
vi.B: Chính người ấy sẽ xây một ngôi nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người sẽ là con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là cha của người, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngai vương quốc người trên Y-sơ-ra-ên vững bền đời đời.'
vi.R: Chính người ấy sẽ xây một ngôi nhà làm đền thờ để tôn vinh danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người sẽ là con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là cha của người. Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngai vua của người trên Y-sơ-ra-ên tồn tại đời đời.'

ko.L: 그가 내 이름을 위하여 집을 지을 것이다. 그리고 그는 나에게 아들이 되고, 나는 그에게 아버지가 될 것이다. 그리고 내가 이스라엘 위에 그의 나라의 왕좌를 영원히 굳게 세우겠다.'
ko.B: 바로 그가 내 이름을 위하여 집을 지을 것이다. 그는 나의 아들이 되고, 나는 그의 아버지가 될 것이다. 나는 이스라엘을 다스리는 그의 왕좌를 영원히 튼튼하게 하겠다.'
ko.R: 바로 그가 내 이름을 높이는 성전을 지을 것이다. 그는 내 아들이 되고, 나는 그의 아버지가 될 것이다. 그리고 나는 그가 이스라엘의 왕으로서 다스리는 일이 영원히 계속되게 하겠다.'

decisions.choice: the promise of 2 Samuel 7:13-14 (1 Chronicles 17:12-13), applied to Solomon by name
decisions.reason: These are the words of the LORD's promise to David through Nathan. There are differences: here "he will be my son" comes before "I will be his father" (the order is reversed from 2 Samuel 7:14 and 1 Chronicles 17:13); the throne clause comes last and adds "over Israel"; and the warning of 2 Samuel 7:14b about punishing the son when he does wrong is absent, as it is in 1 Chronicles 17:13. Nathan spoke of "your offspring"; David now names Solomon as the one meant.

decisions.choice: he will be my son, and I will be his father: a bond of covenant care and loyalty
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:14, the words describe the king's adoption into a close relationship with the LORD, who will care for him and to whom he owes loyalty (compare Psalm 2:7). Hebrews 1:5 quotes them of the Son.

decisions.choice: he will build: he, not you
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stated for emphasis, setting Solomon against David's "you shall not build" in verse 8.

decisions.choice: forever: for all time to come
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:13, the promise to establish the throne has no end in view.

decisions.choice: wording reused from 2 Samuel 7:13-14
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew matches 2 Samuel 7:13-14, all three levels keep the wording used there ("establish", "make firm", "a house to be a temple that honors my name"), changing only what m1 lists.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Samuel 7:13-14 and 1 Chronicles 17:12-13
decisions.reason: The promise is reused in the Spanish wording of those verses at each level.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Samuel 7:13-14
decisions.reason: The promise repeats 2 Samuel 7:13-14, as the English does; the Swahili of those verses is reused at each level.

decisions.choice: wording kept from 2 Samuel 7:13-14 and 1 Chronicles 17:12-13 in Korean
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew matches the promise to David, every level keeps the Korean used there ("굳게 세우겠다", "튼튼하게 하겠다").

source.text: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔י יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֗ וּבָנִ֨יתָ֙ בֵּ֚ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Now, my son, may be Yahweh with you, and you will succeed and you will build [the] house of Yahweh your God, as he spoke concerning you.

en.L: Now, my son, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with you, and may you succeed and build the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has spoken concerning you.
en.B: Now, my son, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with you, so that you prosper as you build the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised concerning you.
en.R: Now, my son, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with you. May you do well and build the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised.

es.L: Ahora, hijo mío, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté contigo, y que prosperes y edifiques la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha dicho acerca de ti.
es.B: Ahora, hijo mío, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté contigo, para que tengas éxito al edificar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo prometió acerca de ti.
es.R: Ahora, hijo mío, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté contigo. Que te vaya bien y construyas el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo prometió.

fr.L: Maintenant, mon fils, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec toi, et tu réussiras et tu bâtiras la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a dit à ton sujet.
fr.B: Maintenant, mon fils, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec toi, afin que tu réussisses à bâtir la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a promis à ton sujet.
fr.R: Maintenant, mon fils, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec toi. Que tu réussisses à construire le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a promis.

sw.L: Sasa, mwanangu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awe pamoja nawe, nawe ufanikiwe na kuijenga nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kama alivyosema kuhusu wewe.
sw.B: Sasa, mwanangu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awe pamoja nawe, ili ufanikiwe unapoijenga nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kama vile alivyoahidi kuhusu wewe.
sw.R: Sasa, mwanangu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awe pamoja nawe. Ufanikiwe na kulijenga hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kama vile alivyoahidi.

vi.L: Bây giờ, con ơi, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng con, để con được thành công và xây nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về con.
vi.B: Bây giờ, con ơi, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng con, để con thành công trong việc xây nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa về con.
vi.R: Bây giờ, con ơi, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng con. Nguyện con làm tốt và xây xong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa.

ko.L: 이제 내 아들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계시기를 바란다. 그리고 네가 형통하여, 그분께서 너에 관하여 말씀하신 대로 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 짓기를 바란다.
ko.B: 이제 내 아들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계셔서, 그분께서 너에 관하여 약속하신 대로 네가 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 잘 짓기를 바란다.
ko.R: 이제 내 아들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계시기를 바란다. 네가 일을 잘해서, 그분께서 약속하신 대로 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 짓기를 바란다.

decisions.choice: may the LORD be with you, and you will succeed: a wish and its result
decisions.reason: The first verb is a wish; the next two carry it on, saying what will follow when the LORD is with Solomon. David now speaks again in his own words, after quoting the LORD in verses 8-10.

decisions.choice: succeed: carry the work through to a good end
decisions.reason: The verb means to prosper or to bring a task to completion. It returns in verse 13, where success depends on keeping the LORD's law.

decisions.choice: just as he promised concerning you
decisions.reason: "Spoke concerning you" refers to the word just quoted in verses 9-10, which is a promise; Balanced and Readable say "promised".

source.text: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן־לְּךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה וִֽיצַוְּךָ֖ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלִשְׁמ֕וֹר אֶת־תּוֹרַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Only may give to you Yahweh insight and understanding, and he will put you in charge over Israel, and to keep [the] law of Yahweh your God.

en.L: Only may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} give you insight and understanding when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} puts you in charge over Israel, so as to keep the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Above all, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} grant you insight and understanding when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sets you over Israel, so that you keep the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Most of all, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make you wise and give you understanding when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes you ruler over Israel. Then you will be able to obey the teaching of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Solo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dé prudencia y entendimiento cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te ponga al frente de Israel, para guardar la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.B: Sobre todo, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te conceda prudencia y entendimiento cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te ponga sobre Israel, para que guardes la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.
es.R: Más que nada, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te haga sabio y te dé entendimiento cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te haga gobernante de Israel. Así podrás obedecer la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios.

fr.L: Seulement, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne du discernement et de l’intelligence, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te mettra à la tête d’Israël, pour garder la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.B: Surtout, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’accorde du discernement et de l’intelligence quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’établira sur Israël, afin que tu observes la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.R: Avant tout, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te rende sage et intelligent quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera de toi le chef d’Israël. Alors tu pourras obéir à l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu.

sw.L: Ila {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akupe busara na ufahamu atakapokuweka kuwa msimamizi juu ya Israeli, ili uishike sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.B: Zaidi ya yote, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akujalie busara na ufahamu atakapokuweka juu ya Israeli, ili uishike sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.R: Zaidi ya yote, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akupe hekima na ufahamu atakapokufanya mtawala juu ya Israeli. Ndipo utaweza kuyatii mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.

vi.L: Chỉ nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho con sự sáng suốt và hiểu biết khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lập con cai quản Y-sơ-ra-ên, để giữ luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con.
vi.B: Trên hết, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho con sự sáng suốt và hiểu biết khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt con cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên, để con giữ luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con.
vi.R: Trên hết mọi điều, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lập con làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên. Khi ấy con sẽ có thể vâng theo lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con.

ko.L: 오직 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 지혜와 명철을 주시기를 바란다. 그분께서 너를 이스라엘 위에 세우실 때에 네가 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법을 지키게 [하시기를 바란다].
ko.B: 무엇보다도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 이스라엘 위에 세우실 때 너에게 지혜와 명철을 주셔서, 네가 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법을 지키게 하시기를 바란다.
ko.R: 무엇보다도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우실 때 너를 지혜롭게 하시고 깨달음을 주시기를 바란다. 그러면 너는 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 지킬 수 있을 것이다.

decisions.choice: insight and understanding: good sense and the ability to judge rightly
decisions.reason: The two words describe practical wisdom for ruling. Solomon later asks the LORD for exactly this (1 Kings 3:9; 2 Chronicles 1:10).

decisions.choice: and he will put you in charge: when he sets you over Israel
alternatives: and may he put you in charge over Israel
decisions.reason: The clause is joined by "and" and may be read as the time when the insight is needed ("when he puts you in charge") or as a further wish ("and may he put you in charge"). Either way Solomon's rule is the LORD's appointment.

decisions.choice: and to keep the law: the purpose of the gift
decisions.reason: The infinitive says what the insight is for: so that Solomon keeps the LORD's law as king.

decisions.choice: the law of the LORD: the LORD's instruction given through Moses
decisions.reason: The word means teaching or instruction, the whole of what the LORD gave Moses for Israel, as verse 13 goes on to say.

decisions.choice: Above all / Most of all; teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: The opening word ("only") singles this wish out as the one that matters most. Readable says "teaching" for the law, as 1 Kings 2:3 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: "율법" (L, B); "가르침" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for the law, as the English Readable does here and at 1 Kings 2:3.

source.text: אָ֣ז תַּצְלִ֔יחַ אִם־תִּשְׁמ֗וֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַל־תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־תֵּחָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Then you will succeed, if you take care to do the statutes and the judgments which commanded Yahweh Moses for Israel. Be strong and be bold; do not fear and do not be dismayed.

en.L: Then you will succeed, if you take care to do the statutes and the judgments that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and bold; do not fear and do not be dismayed.
en.B: Then you will succeed, if you are careful to carry out the statutes and the rulings that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or lose heart.
en.R: You will do well if you are careful to obey the laws and rules that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and brave. Do not be afraid or lose hope.

es.L: Entonces prosperarás, si cuidas de cumplir los estatutos y los decretos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó a Moisés para Israel. Esfuérzate y sé valiente; no temas ni desmayes.
es.B: Entonces tendrás éxito, si cuidas de cumplir los estatutos y las normas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó a Moisés para Israel. Sé fuerte y valiente. No tengas miedo ni te desanimes.
es.R: Te irá bien si tienes cuidado de obedecer las leyes y las normas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Moisés para Israel. Sé fuerte y valiente. No tengas miedo ni pierdas el ánimo.

fr.L: Alors tu réussiras, si tu prends soin de pratiquer les prescriptions et les règles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a commandées à Moïse pour Israël. Sois fort et courageux ; ne crains pas et ne t’effraie pas.
fr.B: Alors tu réussiras, si tu veilles à mettre en pratique les prescriptions et les règles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a données à Moïse pour Israël. Sois fort et courageux ! N’aie pas peur et ne perds pas courage !
fr.R: Tu réussiras si tu fais bien attention à obéir aux lois et aux règles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a données à Moïse pour Israël. Sois fort et courageux ! N’aie pas peur et ne te décourage pas !

sw.L: Ndipo utafanikiwa, ukijihadhari kufanya kanuni na hukumu ambazo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru Musa kwa ajili ya Israeli. Uwe hodari na shujaa; usiogope wala usifadhaike.
sw.B: Ndipo utafanikiwa, ukiwa mwangalifu kutimiza kanuni na maamuzi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru Musa kwa ajili ya Israeli. Uwe hodari na mwenye moyo mkuu. Usiogope wala usikate tamaa.
sw.R: Utafanikiwa ukiwa mwangalifu kutii sheria na kanuni ambazo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Musa kwa ajili ya Israeli. Uwe hodari na jasiri. Usiogope wala usikate tamaa.

vi.L: Bấy giờ con sẽ thành công, nếu con cẩn thận làm theo các luật lệ và mạng lệnh mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se về Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hãy mạnh mẽ và can đảm; đừng sợ hãi, đừng kinh khiếp.
vi.B: Bấy giờ con sẽ thành công, nếu con cẩn thận làm theo các luật lệ và mạng lệnh mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se về Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hãy mạnh mẽ và can đảm lên. Đừng sợ hãi, cũng đừng nản lòng.
vi.R: Con sẽ làm tốt nếu con cẩn thận vâng giữ các luật lệ và quy định mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho Môi-se về Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hãy mạnh mẽ và dũng cảm. Đừng sợ hãi, cũng đừng mất hy vọng.

ko.L: 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 위하여 모세에게 명령하신 규례와 법도를 행하기를 조심하면, 그때 네가 형통할 것이다. 강하고 담대하여라. 두려워하지 말고 놀라지 마라.
ko.B: 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 위하여 모세에게 명령하신 규례와 법도를 조심하여 지키면, 너는 형통할 것이다. 강하고 담대하여라. 두려워하지도 말고 낙심하지도 마라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 위해 모세에게 주신 법과 규칙을 잘 지키면, 너는 모든 일을 잘 해낼 것이다. 힘을 내고 용기를 내라. 두려워하거나 낙심하지 마라.

decisions.choice: be strong and bold; do not fear or be dismayed: the charge to Joshua
decisions.reason: These are the words Moses and the LORD spoke to Joshua (Deuteronomy 31:6-8; Joshua 1:6-9), and the promise of success through keeping the law echoes Joshua 1:7-8. As Moses prepared and Joshua finished the conquest, David prepares and Solomon is to finish the house. David repeats the charge in 28:20; compare 1 Kings 2:2-3.

decisions.choice: then you will succeed, if: success depends on keeping the law
decisions.reason: The promise of verse 11 is tied to a condition: Solomon will succeed if he obeys.

decisions.choice: statutes and judgments: the LORD's laws and rulings
decisions.reason: The pair sums up the commands given through Moses: fixed laws and decisions for cases.

decisions.choice: be dismayed: be shattered, lose heart
decisions.reason: The verb describes being broken in spirit by fear, as in Joshua 1:9.

decisions.choice: be strong and bold (Literal); be strong and courageous (Balanced); be strong and brave (Readable)
decisions.reason: The charge keeps the wording used for Joshua (Joshua 1:9), so the echo can be heard (m1).

decisions.choice: uwe hodari na shujaa (L); hodari na mwenye moyo mkuu (B); hodari na jasiri (R)
decisions.reason: The charge "be strong and bold" takes one wording per level; the statutes and judgments follow the Kings wording ("kanuni, hukumu" L; "kanuni, maamuzi" B; "sheria, kanuni" R).

decisions.choice: "강하고 담대하여라" (L, B); "힘을 내고 용기를 내라" (R)
decisions.reason: The charge echoes the LORD's words to Joshua (Joshua 1:9); Korean keeps one wording per level for this charge through these books.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֨ה בְעָנְיִ֜י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־יְהוָ֗ה זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֤ים מֵֽאָה־אֶ֨לֶף֙ וְכֶ֗סֶף אֶ֤לֶף אֲלָפִים֙ כִּכָּרִ֔ים וְלַנְּחֹ֤שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁקָ֔ל כִּ֥י לָרֹ֖ב הָיָ֑ה וְעֵצִ֤ים וַאֲבָנִים֙ הֲכִינ֔וֹתִי וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תּוֹסִֽיף׃

records.literal_gloss: And here, in my affliction I have prepared for [the] house of Yahweh gold, talents a hundred thousand, and silver, a thousand thousands talents, and the bronze and the iron there [is] no weight, for in abundance it is; and wood and stones I have prepared, and to them you will add.

en.L: And look, in my affliction I have prepared for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gold, 100,000 talents, and silver, 1,000,000 talents, and bronze and iron without weight, for it is in abundance; and timber and stones I have prepared, and to them you will add.
en.B: Look, with hard toil I have provided for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{units:about 7,500,000 pounds|100,000 talents}} of gold and {{units:about 75,000,000 pounds|1,000,000 talents}} of silver, and bronze and iron beyond weighing, there is so much of it. I have also provided timber and stone, and you are to add to them.
en.R: I have worked hard to get things ready for the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I have stored up {{units:about 3,750 tons|100,000 talents}} of gold and {{units:about 37,500 tons|1,000,000 talents}} of silver. There is so much bronze and iron that it cannot be weighed. I have also gathered wood and stone, and you must add more.

es.L: Y he aquí, en mi aflicción he preparado para la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} oro, cien mil talentos, y plata, un millón de talentos, y bronce y hierro sin peso, porque es en abundancia; y madera y piedras he preparado, y a ellas añadirás tú.
es.B: Mira, con mucho esfuerzo he provisto para la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{units:unas 3400 toneladas|100 000 talentos}} de oro y {{units:unas 34 000 toneladas|1 000 000 de talentos}} de plata, y bronce y hierro en tal cantidad que no se pueden pesar. También he provisto madera y piedra, y tú debes añadir más.
es.R: He trabajado mucho para dejar listas las cosas para el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. He guardado {{units:unas 3400 toneladas|100 000 talentos}} de oro y {{units:unas 34 000 toneladas|1 000 000 de talentos}} de plata. Hay tanto bronce y hierro que no se puede pesar. También he reunido madera y piedra, y tú debes añadir más.

fr.L: Et voici, dans ma détresse, j’ai préparé pour la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} de l’or, cent mille talents, et de l’argent, un million de talents ; et le bronze et le fer, sans poids, car il y en a en abondance ; et j’ai préparé du bois et des pierres, et tu y ajouteras.
fr.B: Voici, à force de peine, j’ai amassé pour la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} {{units:environ 3 400 tonnes|cent mille talents}} d’or et {{units:environ 34 000 tonnes|un million de talents}} d’argent, ainsi que du bronze et du fer en si grande quantité qu’on ne peut les peser. J’ai aussi préparé du bois et des pierres, et tu devras en ajouter.
fr.R: J’ai travaillé dur pour tout préparer pour le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. J’ai mis de côté {{units:environ 3 400 tonnes|cent mille talents}} d’or et {{units:environ 34 000 tonnes|un million de talents}} d’argent. Il y a tant de bronze et de fer qu’on ne peut pas les peser. J’ai aussi rassemblé du bois et des pierres, et tu devras en ajouter encore.

sw.L: Na tazama, katika taabu yangu nimeiandalia nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhahabu, talanta 100,000, na fedha, talanta 1,000,000, na shaba na chuma bila kupimwa uzito, kwa maana ni kwa wingi; na mbao na mawe nimeandaa, nawe utaviongeza.
sw.B: Tazama, kwa taabu nyingi nimeiandalia nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{units:karibu tani 3,400|talanta 100,000}} za dhahabu na {{units:karibu tani 34,000|talanta 1,000,000}} za fedha, na shaba na chuma kingi mno kisichoweza kupimwa. Nimeandaa pia mbao na mawe, nawe utapaswa kuviongeza.
sw.R: Nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kuandaa mahitaji ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nimeweka akiba ya {{units:karibu tani 3,400|talanta 100,000}} za dhahabu na {{units:karibu tani 34,000|talanta 1,000,000}} za fedha. Kuna shaba na chuma kingi sana hata hakiwezi kupimwa. Nimekusanya pia mbao na mawe, nawe lazima uongeze zaidi.

vi.L: Kìa, trong lúc khốn khó, cha đã chuẩn bị cho nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} 100.000 ta-lâng vàng, 1.000.000 ta-lâng bạc, cùng đồng và sắt không cân được, vì nhiều quá; cha cũng đã chuẩn bị gỗ và đá, và con sẽ thêm vào đó.
vi.B: Kìa, với biết bao khó nhọc, cha đã chuẩn bị cho nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} {{units:khoảng 3.400 tấn|100.000 ta-lâng}} vàng và {{units:khoảng 34.000 tấn|1.000.000 ta-lâng}} bạc, cùng đồng và sắt nhiều đến nỗi không cân được. Cha cũng đã chuẩn bị gỗ và đá, và con phải thêm vào đó.
vi.R: Cha đã làm việc vất vả để chuẩn bị cho đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Cha đã dự trữ {{units:khoảng 3.400 tấn|100.000 ta-lâng}} vàng và {{units:khoảng 34.000 tấn|1.000.000 ta-lâng}} bạc. Đồng và sắt nhiều đến nỗi không thể cân được. Cha cũng đã thu góp gỗ và đá, và con phải thêm vào nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 내가 고난 가운데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 위하여 금 10만 달란트와 은 100만 달란트를 준비했고, 놋쇠와 철은 너무 많아서 무게를 달 수 없다. 그리고 내가 나무와 돌도 준비했으니, 너는 거기에 더하여라.
ko.B: 보아라, 내가 힘써 수고하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 위하여 금 {{units:3,400톤쯤|10만 달란트}}과 은 {{units:34,000톤쯤|100만 달란트}}을 마련했고, 놋쇠와 철은 너무 많아서 무게를 달 수도 없다. 나무와 돌도 마련해 두었으니, 너는 거기에 더 보태라.
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 위해 애써서 준비해 왔다. 금 {{units:3,400톤쯤|10만 달란트}}과 은 {{units:34,000톤쯤|100만 달란트}}을 모아 두었다. 놋쇠와 철은 너무 많아서 무게를 달 수도 없다. 나무와 돌도 모아 두었으니, 너는 더 보태야 한다.

decisions.choice: in my affliction: with great effort and hardship
decisions.reason: The noun means affliction, hardship or lowliness. It may mean David gathered these things through hard toil, or in the middle of the troubles of his reign, or in his humble state compared with the greatness of the task. The first fits David's point best: he has gone to great lengths for the house.

decisions.choice: 100,000 talents of gold and 1,000,000 talents of silver: an immense amount, perhaps not meant as an exact figure
alternatives: exact weights of the usual talent
decisions.reason: At about 75 pounds to the talent, this is about 3,750 tons of gold and 37,500 tons of silver, far beyond any other figure in Scripture: Solomon's yearly gold was 666 talents (1 Kings 10:14), and David's own later gift is 3,000 talents of gold and 7,000 of silver (29:4). The numbers may be deliberate overstatement, matching "beyond weighing" in the same verse, to stress that David spared nothing; they may be round sums; or the talent used may have been lighter than the usual one. The Hebrew gives no hint which, and the figures are translated as written.

decisions.choice: there is no weight, for it is in abundance: too much to weigh
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the bronze and iron are said to be beyond measuring.

decisions.choice: to them you will add: an instruction to Solomon
decisions.reason: The future verb here gives Solomon his task: he is to add to what David has gathered.

decisions.choice: about 7,500,000 pounds; about 75,000,000 pounds (Balanced); about 3,750 tons; about 37,500 tons (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the weight in modern measure, with the talents as the alternative, as 1 Kings 10:14 does; Readable rounds to tons, which are easier to picture. Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: unas 3400 toneladas; unas 34 000 toneladas
decisions.reason: At 34 kg a talent, as in the Spanish of Kings; the Spanish gives metric tonnes at Balanced and Readable, where the English has pounds and tons.

decisions.choice: "environ 3 400 tonnes"; "environ 34 000 tonnes" at Balanced and Readable
alternatives: pounds at Balanced and tons at Readable, as in the English
decisions.reason: French converts the talent at 34 kg into tonnes at both levels, as the Kings terms note sets.

decisions.choice: karibu tani 3,400; karibu tani 34,000 (talanta 100,000; talanta 1,000,000)
decisions.reason: The metric default reckons a talent at 34 kg at both levels, where the English gives pounds at Balanced and US tons at Readable; Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 3.400 tấn|100.000 ta-lâng}}; {{units:khoảng 34.000 tấn|1.000.000 ta-lâng}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default at 34 kg a talent, the original unit as the alternative; the same values at Balanced and Readable, where the English uses pounds at one level and tons at the other.

decisions.choice: {{units:3,400톤쯤|10만 달란트}}; {{units:34,000톤쯤|100만 달란트}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default (talent 34 kg), rounded to tonnes at both levels so the amounts can be pictured; the talents are the alternative, and Literal keeps "금 10만 달란트", "은 100만 달란트".

source.text: וְעִמְּךָ֤ לָרֹב֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י מְלָאכָ֔ה חֹצְבִ֕ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֥י אֶ֖בֶן וָעֵ֑ץ וְכָל־חָכָ֖ם בְּכָל־מְלָאכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And with you in abundance [are] doers of work: stonecutters and craftsmen of stone and wood, and every skilled [one] in every work.

en.L: And with you in abundance [are] doers of work: stonecutters and craftsmen of stone and wood, and every skilled [one] in every work.
en.B: You also have workers in great numbers: stonecutters, craftsmen in stone and wood, and every kind of worker skilled for every task.
en.R: You have plenty of workers too. There are people who cut stone, builders who work with stone and wood, and people skilled in every kind of work.

es.L: Y contigo [hay] en abundancia hacedores de obra: canteros y artesanos de piedra y de madera, y todo experto en toda obra.
es.B: También tienes trabajadores en abundancia: canteros, artesanos de la piedra y de la madera, y toda clase de expertos para cualquier trabajo.
es.R: También tienes muchos trabajadores. Hay gente que corta piedra, constructores que trabajan con piedra y madera, y personas expertas en toda clase de trabajo.

fr.L: Et avec toi, en abondance, [il y a] des ouvriers : tailleurs de pierre, et artisans de la pierre et du bois, et tout homme habile en tout ouvrage.
fr.B: Tu as aussi avec toi des ouvriers en grand nombre : des tailleurs de pierre, des artisans de la pierre et du bois, et toutes sortes de gens habiles pour toutes sortes de travaux.
fr.R: Tu as aussi beaucoup d’ouvriers. Il y a des gens qui taillent la pierre, des bâtisseurs qui travaillent la pierre et le bois, et des gens habiles dans toutes sortes de métiers.

sw.L: Na pamoja nawe kwa wingi [wapo] watenda kazi: wachonga mawe na mafundi wa mawe na mbao, na kila stadi katika kila kazi.
sw.B: Pia una wafanyakazi wengi: wachonga mawe, mafundi wa mawe na mbao, na kila aina ya mtu stadi kwa kila kazi.
sw.R: Una pia wafanyakazi wengi. Kuna watu wa kuchonga mawe, mafundi wa kujenga kwa mawe na mbao, na watu stadi wa kila aina ya kazi.

vi.L: Con có rất nhiều người làm công việc: thợ đẽo đá, thợ đá và thợ mộc, và mọi người thành thạo trong mọi công việc.
vi.B: Con cũng có rất nhiều thợ: thợ đẽo đá, thợ xây đá, thợ mộc, và đủ mọi người thợ giỏi cho mọi công việc.
vi.R: Con cũng có rất nhiều thợ. Có những người đẽo đá, những thợ xây làm việc với đá và gỗ, và những người giỏi đủ mọi nghề.

ko.L: 그리고 너와 함께 일하는 사람이 많다. 석수와 돌과 나무를 다루는 장인과 온갖 일에 능숙한 모든 사람이 [있다].
ko.B: 너에게는 일꾼도 많다. 석수와 돌과 나무를 다루는 장인과 온갖 일에 솜씨 있는 사람들이 있다.
ko.R: 너에게는 일꾼도 많다. 돌을 떠내는 사람들과 돌과 나무로 집을 짓는 사람들과 온갖 일에 솜씨 있는 사람들이 있다.

decisions.choice: stonecutters; craftsmen of stone and wood: those who quarry stone, and those who shape and build with stone and timber
decisions.reason: The first word names the men who cut stone from the rock (as in verse 2); the second names skilled builders and carpenters who work the stone and wood into the house.

decisions.choice: skilled: wise in a craft
decisions.reason: The word usually translated "wise" also means skilled in a trade, as of the craftsmen who made the tabernacle (Exodus 31:6; 35:10).

decisions.choice: workers; people skilled
decisions.reason: "Doers of work" and "every skilled one" do not name men or women; Balanced and Readable use words that are just as open.

source.text: לַזָּהָ֥ב לַכֶּ֛סֶף וְלַנְּחֹ֥שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר ק֣וּם וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Of the gold, of the silver, and of the bronze and of the iron there is no number. Arise and act, and may be Yahweh with you.

en.L: Of the gold, of the silver, and of the bronze and of the iron there is no number. Arise and act, and may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with you."
en.B: The gold and silver, the bronze and iron, are beyond counting. Now get up and go to work, and may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with you."
en.R: You have more gold, silver, bronze and iron than anyone can count. So get started on the work, and may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be with you!"

es.L: Del oro, de la plata, y del bronce y del hierro no hay número. Levántate y actúa, y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté contigo».
es.B: El oro y la plata, el bronce y el hierro, no se pueden contar. Ahora levántate y manos a la obra, y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté contigo».
es.R: Tienes más oro, plata, bronce y hierro de lo que nadie puede contar. Así que comienza el trabajo, ¡y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} esté contigo!».

fr.L: L’or, l’argent, et le bronze, et le fer, il n’y en a pas de nombre. Lève-toi et agis, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec toi ! »
fr.B: L’or et l’argent, le bronze et le fer sont innombrables. Lève-toi donc et mets-toi à l’œuvre, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec toi ! »
fr.R: Tu as plus d’or, d’argent, de bronze et de fer qu’on ne peut en compter. Alors commence le travail, et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit avec toi ! »

sw.L: Dhahabu, fedha, shaba na chuma hazina hesabu. Inuka ufanye kazi, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awe pamoja nawe."
sw.B: Dhahabu na fedha, shaba na chuma, haviwezi kuhesabika. Sasa inuka uanze kazi, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awe pamoja nawe."
sw.R: Una dhahabu, fedha, shaba na chuma kingi kuliko mtu yeyote anavyoweza kuhesabu. Basi anza kazi, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na awe pamoja nawe!"

vi.L: Vàng, bạc, đồng và sắt thì không đếm xuể. Hãy đứng dậy mà làm, và nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng con."
vi.B: Vàng, bạc, đồng và sắt thì nhiều không đếm xuể. Bây giờ hãy đứng dậy bắt tay vào việc, và nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng con."
vi.R: Con có vàng, bạc, đồng và sắt nhiều đến nỗi không ai đếm được. Vậy hãy bắt đầu công việc, và nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng con!"

ko.L: 금과 은과 놋쇠와 철은 셀 수가 없다. 일어나 일하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계시기를 바란다."
ko.B: 금과 은과 놋쇠와 철은 헤아릴 수 없이 많다. 이제 일어나 일을 시작하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계시기를 바란다."
ko.R: 너에게는 아무도 셀 수 없을 만큼 많은 금과 은과 놋쇠와 철이 있다. 그러니 이제 일을 시작하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계시기를 바란다!"

decisions.choice: of the gold ... there is no number: the metals are beyond counting
alternatives: skilled in gold, silver, bronze and iron, without number
decisions.reason: The verse can be read as its own sentence about the metals, or as carrying on verse 15: craftsmen skilled "in gold, silver, bronze and iron", beyond number. The words "there is no number" stand after the metals, which favors the first reading.

decisions.choice: arise and act: begin the work
decisions.reason: "Arise" before another command urges action, as the LORD says to Joshua "arise, cross" (Joshua 1:2); it does not mean standing up.

decisions.choice: may the LORD be with you: a blessing
decisions.reason: David closes his charge with the wish he began with in verse 11.

decisions.choice: get up and go to work / get started on the work
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps a hint of the "arise" picture; Readable gives the plain sense (m2).

records.literal_gloss: And commanded David all [the] princes of Israel to help Solomon his son.

en.L: And David commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son.
en.B: Then David ordered all the officials of Israel to help his son Solomon.
en.R: Then David told all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.

es.L: Y mandó David a todos los príncipes de Israel que ayudaran a Salomón su hijo.
es.B: Luego David ordenó a todos los jefes de Israel que ayudaran a su hijo Salomón.
es.R: Luego David les dijo a todos los líderes de Israel que ayudaran a su hijo Salomón.

fr.L: Et David ordonna à tous les princes d’Israël d’aider Salomon son fils.
fr.B: Puis David ordonna à tous les dignitaires d’Israël d’aider son fils Salomon.
fr.R: Ensuite David a demandé à tous les chefs d’Israël d’aider son fils Salomon.

sw.B: Kisha Daudi akawaamuru maafisa wote wa Israeli wamsaidie mwanawe Sulemani.
