vi.L: Đa-vít truyền cho tất cả các thủ lĩnh Y-sơ-ra-ên giúp đỡ Sa-lô-môn con trai mình.
vi.B: Rồi Đa-vít ra lệnh cho tất cả các quan chức Y-sơ-ra-ên giúp đỡ Sa-lô-môn con trai mình.
vi.R: Rồi Đa-vít bảo tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên giúp đỡ Sa-lô-môn con trai mình.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 이스라엘의 모든 고관에게 자기 아들 솔로몬을 도우라고 명령했다.
ko.B: 그러고 나서 다윗은 이스라엘의 모든 관리에게 자기 아들 솔로몬을 도우라고 명령했다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 다윗은 이스라엘의 모든 지도자에게 자기 아들 솔로몬을 도우라고 말했다.

decisions.choice: the princes of Israel: the leading men and officials of the nation
decisions.reason: The word names men with authority: tribal heads, royal officials and commanders. Chapter 23 begins the lists of the leaders and Levites David gathered.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The usual wording for this title in these books.

decisions.choice: "고관" (L); "관리" (B); "지도자" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for *sarim* (princes, officials, leaders) through these chapters, as 19:3 has "고관" and "지도자".

source.text: הֲלֹ֨א יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵנִ֥יחַ לָכֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֣י׀נָתַ֣ן בְּיָדִ֗י אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [Is] not Yahweh your God with you, and has he given rest to you from round about? For he has given into my hand the inhabitants of the land, and is subdued the land before Yahweh and before his people.

en.L: "[Is] not {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God with you? And has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not given you rest all around? For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given into my hand the inhabitants of the land, and the land is subdued before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.B: "Is not {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God with you? Has {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not given you rest on every side? For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has handed the people who lived in the land over to me, and the land lies subdued before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.R: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is with you. He has given you rest from war on every side. He has let me defeat the people who lived in the land, and now the land is under the control of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.

es.L: «¿No [está] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios con ustedes|vuestro Dios con vosotros}}? ¿Y no {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado reposo por todas partes? Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha entregado en mi mano a los habitantes de la tierra, y la tierra ha sido sometida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.B: «¿No está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios con ustedes|vuestro Dios con vosotros}}? ¿No {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado reposo por todos lados? Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me ha entregado a los que vivían en la tierra, y la tierra está sometida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.R: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios está con ustedes|vuestro Dios está con vosotros}}. Él {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado descanso de la guerra por todos lados. Me ha dejado vencer a los que vivían en la tierra, y ahora la tierra está bajo el control {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.

fr.L: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu n’[est-il] pas avec vous ? Et ne vous a-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas donné du repos de tous côtés ? Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a livré entre mes mains les habitants du pays, et le pays est soumis devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu n’est-il pas avec vous ? Ne vous a-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas donné du repos de tous côtés ? Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a livré les habitants du pays, et le pays est soumis devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

sw.L: "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu [si] pamoja nanyi? Na je, hakuwapa raha pande zote? Kwa maana amewatia wenyeji wa nchi mkononi mwangu, na nchi imetiishwa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu si pamoja nanyi? Je, hakuwapa raha pande zote? Kwa maana amewatia mikononi mwangu wale walioishi katika nchi, nayo nchi imetiishwa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu yu pamoja nanyi. Amewapa raha, bila vita pande zote. Amenipa ushindi juu ya watu walioishi katika nchi hii, na sasa nchi iko chini ya mamlaka ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: "Chẳng phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời các ông ở cùng các ông sao? Chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho các ông được yên nghỉ khắp chung quanh sao? Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trao dân cư trong xứ vào tay ta, và xứ đã bị khuất phục trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trước mặt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: "Chẳng phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời các ông ở cùng các ông sao? Chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho các ông được yên ổn khắp bốn phía sao? Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trao dân cư trong xứ vào tay ta, và xứ đã quy phục {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời các ông đang ở cùng các ông. Ngài đã cho các ông được yên ổn, không còn chiến tranh bốn phía. Ngài đã cho ta đánh bại dân cư trong xứ, và nay xứ ở dưới quyền của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: "너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 함께 계시지 않느냐? 그리고 그분께서 너희에게 사방으로 안식을 주시지 않았느냐? 그분께서 이 땅의 주민들을 내 손에 넘겨주셨고, 이 땅이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞과 그분의 백성 앞에 굴복했다.
ko.B: "너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 함께 계시지 않느냐? 그분께서 너희에게 사방으로 평안을 주시지 않았느냐? 그분께서 이 땅에 살던 사람들을 내 손에 넘겨주셨고, 이 땅은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그분의 백성 앞에 굴복했다.
ko.R: "너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 함께 계신다. 그분께서 너희를 둘러싼 모든 적과의 싸움을 그치게 하셨다. 그분께서 나에게 이 땅에 살던 사람들을 이기게 해 주셨다. 이제 이 땅은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그분의 백성의 다스림을 받고 있다.

decisions.choice: is not the LORD with you, and has he not given you rest?: questions that expect "yes"
decisions.reason: The questions state what the leaders already know. David speaks to them directly, though the Hebrew does not introduce the speech with "saying".

decisions.choice: rest all around and the land subdued: the time for the LORD's house has come
decisions.reason: Rest from enemies was the sign that the place for the LORD's name should be built (Deuteronomy 12:10-11; 2 Samuel 7:1). "The land was subdued before them" recalls Joshua 18:1, when the tent of meeting was set up at Shiloh once the land was won. The word "rest" also ties back to the "man of rest" of verse 9.

decisions.choice: given into my hand: given me victory over
decisions.reason: To give someone "into the hand" of another is to put them in his power.

decisions.choice: statements in place of questions; rest from war; let me defeat
decisions.reason: Readable turns the questions into the statements they imply (m1), says what the rest was from, and explains "given into my hand" (m3).

decisions.choice: plural_you: su Dios con ustedes / vuestro Dios con vosotros
decisions.reason: David speaks to all the leaders together, so every "you" in verses 18-19 is plural and takes the setting.

decisions.choice: "votre", "vous" (plural)
decisions.reason: The English "you" here is plural: David now speaks to the leaders of verse 17, so French changes to "vous".

decisions.choice: Mungu wenu, nanyi (plural)
decisions.reason: David now speaks to the officials of verse 17, and the Hebrew "you" here is plural; Swahili must choose, and uses the plural forms "wenu", "nanyi", "-wa-".

decisions.choice: The king says "ta" and "các ông" to the leaders of Israel
decisions.reason: David speaks to the nation's leaders with the respect he gives the Levite heads in 15:12; a reviewer may prefer the king's "các ngươi" of the Samuel note.

decisions.choice: David speaks to the leaders in 해라체 with "너희"
decisions.reason: A king giving orders to his officials, as the Samuel note sets; in 13:2 and 28:2 he speaks to the whole assembly more formally.

en.L: Now set your heart and your soul to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and arise and build the sanctuary of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God, to bring the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the holy vessels of God into the house built for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: Now set your heart and soul on seeking {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Get up and build the sanctuary of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God, so that the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the sacred vessels of God can be brought into the house that is to be built for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Now commit yourselves with all your heart and soul to seeking {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Start building the holy place of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} God. Then the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the holy objects used in God's worship can be carried into the temple built to honor the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

decisions.choice: set your heart and your soul: give your whole self
decisions.reason: "Heart" is the mind and will, and "soul" (nefesh) the whole living self with its desires. Together they mean complete devotion, as in Deuteronomy 4:29 and 6:5.

decisions.choice: seek the LORD: turn to him in worship and obedience
decisions.reason: To seek the LORD is to look to him, worship him and ask his will. It is a key theme of Chronicles: Saul died because he did not seek the LORD (10:13-14), and the ark was neglected in his days (13:3).

decisions.choice: the ark and the holy vessels: brought together into one house
decisions.reason: The ark was in a tent in Jerusalem (16:1; 17:1), while the tabernacle and its altar stood at Gibeon (16:39; 21:29). The new house will bring them together; 2 Chronicles 5:2-7 tells how it was done.

decisions.choice: sanctuary; the house to be built: the holy place still to be built
decisions.reason: "Sanctuary" means a holy place set apart for God. The participle "built" points to a house not yet standing.

decisions.choice: holy place; holy objects used in God's worship
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for "sanctuary" and "holy vessels" and keeps "ark", as these books do.
